about_the_game:
What can you find in the mind of a daydreamer?

  • 2 playable characters → 2 very different experiences with different content 

  • choices and actions (and lack thereof) have consequences 

  • story rich

  • character focused

  • very replayable

  • lots of lore 

  • complicated families 

  • a world that is more odd than it might seem at first glance

  • repression, perversion and shame

Don't be fooled by the cute colorful chidlish simple art style - this game is not for children. It contains adult and disturbing themes. Meant for mature audiences only.

Welcome to The Shame of a Daydreamer!

This is a character and story focused rpg game where choices have severe consequences, and shame and mental health affects possibilities and limitations, set in a world that's like a minefield where your actions can cause the world to reach a dead end. 

The game takes place during 7 days - Monday to Sunday. There will be several different possible endings. 

Play as either Elias or Felix and discover their filthy secrets, get to know their complicated families and try to reach Sunday without fucking everything up.

Who are these boys you can play as ? Which one should you play as? Let's ask the parents of the boys!

Elliott, tell me about your son. 

Elliott: "Hmm ... Elias ... Well ... He's ... a psychopathic pervert and aggressive animal who began life by murdering his own mother. Don't play as him. Who knows what he's capable of ..."

Okay ...

Levi, should I play as your son, Felix, (or as you call him, Cain)?

Levi: "Ha! Sure, if you want to play as a pathetic coward and special snowflake with strong school shooter vibes that will probably end up becoming an incel ..."

Do you trust the words of the parents..? What kind of people are these boys,  actually......?

Which character you choose to play as will greatly affect your experience, and it’s recommended to try to play as both characters to get the fullest picture of their world and understand how and why it can reach a dead end because of your choices or lack thereof, and to figure out how to avoid it happening.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains adult themes of sexual and violent nature. 
There will be depictions of sensitive topics usch as sexual violence, depression, anxiety, self hate, suicide, trauma and shame. There will be themes of harmful family relations and dynamics. Most of the sexual and violent themes will be depicted only through text, however, there will be some light nudity and violent visuals as well, and also use of alcohol and light drugs.

short_description: In the mind of a daydreamer you find a shameful story set in a world that hides filthy secrets, disturbing lore and complicated families behind cute colors. Be careful - or don’t be. But your choices and actions will have consequences. And sometimes the results can be … inhuman.
